text_block_list.text:
Lately, Satono Diamond has been acting 
strange.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Nnh, bitter...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
For a bit of nutrition, um... I brought 
some sweets I accidentally burned a 
little.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sugar sure is impatient, isn't it? 
Tomorrow, I'll definitely become good 
friends with it!

In that manner, I cook every day, 
something I usually never do. Not only 
that—

One afternoon. Just as I was about to 
start training, it began to rain.

Satono Diamond in particular was supposed 
to dislike rain. Just as I was wondering 
what to do...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! It worked! Hanging the teru teru 
bozu upside-down really paid off♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's raining, after all! Let's 
make the most of it, Trainer!

“—And in such manner, something out of the 
ordinary could be observed.”

I was hesitant to pry into her personal 
life. Thinking that, I hadn't asked 
before, but... This is a critical time.
choice_data_list: Fewer worries is always better, right?
Fewer worries is always better, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—It's delicious! A Florentine, was it? 
It's super tasty, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's sweet, and it feels like 
it'll blow away all my fatigue. Maybe it'd 
make a nice snack for my next rainy-day 
fishing trip, too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll take it with me! And next time, 
I'm definitely going to land a big one...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Would you like some too, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Here are some snacks, and... if you're 
interested, we have rain-fishing too!
choice_data_list: You made these sweets really well.
These sweets turned out really well!
Weren't you bad with rainy weather?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Here are some snacks, and... if you're 
interested, we have rain-fishing too!
choice_data_list: You made these sweets really well.
These sweets turned out really well!
Weren't you bad with rainy weather?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much♪ I ended up 
pushing myself a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"No way! Far from just a little, I worked 
reaaallly hard, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
At first, they were undercooked or burnt 
to a crisp... Um, it was pretty tough 
eating them!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"And in the end, you pulled it off just 
like you said at the start—'cooking 
without a clock'!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Without relying on tools... or anything at 
all, I want to be able to set my own pace.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because in the race, my body is all I 
have.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is why I tried baking without using a 
timer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Until the body memorizes the sense of 
time. Over and over again.
choice_data_list: To think you were working that hard...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I am still an unpolished gem, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even if you expect brilliance, without 
polishing, it is merely an ordinary stone.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I have to polish it. Polish it, hone it, 
polish it, hone it...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a "great Umamusume" 
worthy of shining as the treasure of 
Satono... No.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I must. —To carve open my own destiny!

Knowing her will and the effort she's put 
in, there's no way I could just sit by and 
do nothing as her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
! Yes! Together—please help polish this 
diamond.

From that day forward, the "Satono Diamond 
Polishing Project" officially began!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! It's precisely because I'm not good 
at it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The other day, I went rainy-day fishing 
with Cheval-san, and she taught me all 
kinds of things.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How to walk and brace yourself on slippery 
ground... and even enjoying the sound of 
rain♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... But I didn't catch anything big 
that day...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Next time is my revenge! I'll definitely 
reel in a big one!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No one can change the weather for a race. 
But just because conditions are tough, 
that doesn't make losing acceptable. If 
so—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I realized that the only choice I had was 
to change myself!
